description: The initial registration procedure in 5G NAS.

parameters: UE determined PLMN with disaster condition IE

conditionals.condition: If UE is operating in dual-registration mode and is in EMM state EMM-REGISTERED
conditionals.next_action: Include UE status IE with EMM registration status

conditionals.condition: If the UE supports and requests MICO mode
If UE supports S1 mode, hasn't disabled E-UTRA capability and is not performing disaster roaming initial registration
conditionals.next_action: Include the S1 mode bit in the 5GMM capability IE

conditionals.condition: If UE doesn't have a valid 5G NAS security context
conditionals.next_action: Send the REGISTRATION REQUEST message without including the NAS message container IE

conditionals.condition: If SUCI is included in the 5GS mobile identity IE and timer T3519 is not running
conditionals.next_action: Start timer T3519 and store the SUCI
